now.title: What If...?
now.text: In episode 5, Ebony Maw and Cull Obsidian land on Earth, where zombies overwhelm them and turn them into the undead.

proposed.text: In episode 5, Ebony Maw and Cull Obsidian land on Earth, where zombies turn them into the undead before Hope's ants strip them to the bone.

changes.evidence: In What If...? episode 5 (What If... Zombies?!), after both are zombified, a swarm of ants controlled by Hope van Dyne strips Maw to his bones and reduces Obsidian to dust; both die in May 2018 in that episode. The file leaves them At large.

now.title: Inhumans
now.text: Eldrac carries the people of Attilan to Earth and dies with the city.

changes.evidence: Inhumans episode 8: Eldrac, a wall in Attilan, teleports the people to Earth and dies when the building collapses on him as Attilan falls. Both the transport and his death happen in Attilan, not Hawaii.

now.title: Inhumans
now.text: Won over by Karnak, Auran gives him her blood to revive Gorgon. She refuses Maximus's order to kill Medusa, leaves him, and joins the evacuation to Earth.

changes.evidence: Inhumans episodes 7-8: Auran helps Karnak revive Gorgon using the Terrigen chambers in the palace, refuses Maximus's order to kill Medusa and leaves him, all in Attilan, before evacuating to Earth. Attilan is missing.

now.title: Inhumans
now.text: Gorgon goes to Earth to find Triton, rescues Karnak and Jen, and dies saving the others from Mordis. Brought back by Terrigenesis with a wild mind, he kills Declan and begins to remember his family.

changes.evidence: Inhumans episodes 7-8: Gorgon's body is taken back to Attilan, where Karnak's second Terrigenesis revives him; he kills Declan there and is locked in the Quiet Room before evacuating to Earth. Attilan is missing.

now.title: Inhumans
now.text: Lockjaw sends Karnak to Oahu, where he is captured by cannabis growers and falls for Jen. He later revives Gorgon through a second Terrigenesis and escapes Maximus's cell with him.

changes.evidence: Inhumans episodes 7-8: Karnak revives Gorgon in the palace Terrigen chamber in Attilan and breaks out of the Quiet Room with him there. Attilan is missing.

now.title: Blade II
now.text: Blade finds Whistler held as a vampire and cures him.

changes.evidence: Blade II opens in Prague, where Blade finds Whistler held as a vampire and cures him. The place is empty.

now.title: Blade: The Series
now.text: In episode 2, Marcus Van Sciver turns Krista into a vampire, and Blade's serum lets her fight her thirst. She goes undercover in the House of Chthon to help Blade bring down Marcus.
cases: PR-011 The Conclave Massacre (Blade: The Series)

changes.evidence: The record covers the two-part pilot (episodes 1-2): Krista is turned and goes undercover. Marcus unleashes his weapon against the purebloods only in the series finale (episode 13, 'Conclave'), so the Conclave Massacre report does not match this record.

now.title: Fantastic Four (2005)
now.text: Johnny gains fiery powers on Doom's station, names the team the Fantastic Four, and loves the fame.

proposed.text: Johnny gains fiery powers on Doom's station, gives each of the team a code name, and loves the fame.

changes.evidence: In Fantastic Four (2005), the media dubs the team 'The Fantastic Four' after the Brooklyn Bridge rescue; Johnny is the one who names them Human Torch, Invisible Woman, Mr. Fantastic and the Thing.
